surface: claude -p --output-format stream-json standard output (StdoutMessage: the SDKMessage union, active_goal and, with --input-format stream-json, the control protocol); not the session transcript files

source.method: reviewed reading of the pinned npm artifacts (file sha256 above). Claude Code is closed source; the published declaration of its stream-json output is the Agent SDK's sdk.d.ts, whose StdoutMessage type is documented as everything the CLI writes to stdout in stream-json mode (the SDKMessage union, SDKActiveGoalMessage and the control protocol). Package @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.304: registry integrity sha512-Ivkt7/UAkATibzvqT31eY71lAp7YdPzfbKDpmbHN9+AQWFh/Ac6tYkL2J1sipJ7tU4IK48w0YxuRW9aI//veFA== (re-computed over the fetched tarball), shasum 2f89b45da4833c76f36a286ea11263bb1f2ad36c; its package.json declares claudeCodeVersion 2.1.304, published 2026-10-19 one minute after @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.304. sdk.d.ts imports BetaMessage, BetaRawMessageStreamEvent, BetaUsage and MessageParam from the peer @anthropic-ai/sdk (>=0.93.0); the CLI is a native binary and the API types version it bundles is not published, so the content-block, stream-event and usage members are read from @anthropic-ai/sdk@0.135.0 (files prefixed api/; integrity sha512-WWrdL57JhU5KoynpTjt9GXK6k7ud9nPw2uw/Trn+oBXh6s0KpjhAccWZm2Qxw08ARYG1UDQj5iC+JO42j1rt/g==), the latest release before 2026-10-19 and inside the peer range: a stated choice, not proof of the bundled version. Variant names follow the claude_stream raw inventory (type; system/<subtype>; user/tool_result when a tool_result block is present; result without subtype). Paths join members with '.', arrays with '[]', map keys with '{*}'; message.content[].input, tool_use_result and permission_denials[].tool_input are tool data listed as one path. No TypeScript parsing or pattern extraction: a refresh re-reads the files when their sha256 change
source.secondary_declaration: sdk.d.ts is a filtered publication: members internal to the CLI are elided from the type bodies (visible as runs of blank lines), so recorded output carries members it does not declare. Reconciliation against the accepted 2.1.303 specification and the committed 2.1.299/2.1.304 fixtures found, undeclared: assistant thinking_display, thinking_duration_ms, wire_tool_inputs; user/tool_result tool_result_meta[] (id, permission_decision{decision, source, reason_type}, non_execution_kind); result subagent_stats, safety_stops; system/init original_cwd, additional_directories, memory_paths, messaging_socket_path, per_turn_effort_active, analytics_disabled, product_feedback_disabled; system/task_notification handback, handback_report; rate_limit_event rate_limit_info.unifiedWindows. These are observed extras for review, not declarations, and are not listed as fields. sdk-tools.d.ts declares per-tool input/output shapes for the tool-data payloads and is not inventoried path by path. The Python SDK types.py used earlier as an external cross-check is not the authority for this inventory

omitted_by_projection.what: final stop reason and final usage of each API response
omitted_by_projection.consequence: streamed assistant block-messages carry stop_reason null and non-final usage; the turn's stop reason and totals arrive only on the result (per-response values are only in stream_event message_delta, emitted on request)
a prompt given to -p is not echoed; a client-sent user message is echoed only as a replay (isReplay) when replay is requested with stream-json input
token-level text/thinking/tool-input deltas exist only with --include-partial-messages

omitted_by_projection.what: hook lifecycle except SessionStart and Setup
omitted_by_projection.consequence: hook executions are invisible unless hook events are requested

omitted_by_projection.what: subagent, sidechain and auxiliary model calls in result.usage
omitted_by_projection.consequence: usage is the main agent loop per turn only; modelUsage covers the query pipeline but excludes internal helper calls (permission classifier, token-count probes)

omitted_by_projection.what: denials decided before the permission layer
omitted_by_projection.consequence: PreToolUse hook denies, deny-rule overrides of hook decisions, path-scoped file-tool deny rules and the MCP permission-prompt-tool surface emit no permission_denied frame; result.permission_denials is the authoritative record

omitted_by_projection.what: thinking text during the redacted-thinking phase
omitted_by_projection.consequence: only a running token estimate is reported while the API streams pings
nothing is emitted at process start; consumers reset to empty
a call that stepped aside for a user message carries {detachedToolCall: true} in tool_use_result; its result reaches the model in a later turn
timestamp is the originating host's clock, for display only, and older emitters omit it; most other families carry no time
